head: b86b5d5ad84bce900762defa094630eb358317a6
provided_live_context: Root reports draft PR6469 with exact b86 and normal CI/feature-matrix/aggregate started; benchmark run34358709884 completed unusually quickly. Agent made no API read, so this report attributes source conditions, not actual job conclusions.
recommendation: Do not wait for draft-skipped heavy evidence. After current review/validation state is acceptable, root can use the normal ready_for_review transition; all four relevant workflows subscribe. This patch changes .github/feature-matrix.d, a full-selection trigger, so no ci-full/bench-full toggle is needed to force affected closure. Root owns transition and verifies real execution; no dispatch or alternative admission path.

findings.finding: run + track benchmarks requires draft != true. ci-full/bench-full label admission is ANDed with the non-draft guard, so neither overrides draft skipping. A draft workflow success therefore cannot establish deterministic perf/wasm/memory execution. Actual run job metadata/logs still need inspection.

Heavy vector recall shard step returns success without running on draft. coverage-measure, coverage-engine-run and aggregate coverage are guarded off on draft; instrumented measures also skip merge_group. Bulk workspace test shards, lint and the new opt-in test leg are not removed by that heavy-draft rule.

ready_for_review triggers fresh normal runs on the same head with draft false. CI, feature-matrix and aggregate also have merge_group; current bench.yml does not declare merge_group, so required executed perf evidence must be secured on the full PR/current main path, not inferred from queue-only success.

Draft aggregate is gate, draft-tier, never required gate. A full-tier PR gate rejects unsuperseded per-workflow draft selector evidence. Root should inspect successor identity for each selecting workflow; one green selector cannot replace unrelated draft evidence.

labeled/unlabeled events do real CI/feature-matrix work only for ci-full; benchmarks admit ci-full or bench-full. ci-full presence sends --full to selection, but draft guards remain. Other unrelated labels are guarded no-leg events. ci-summary itself has no labeled/unlabeled trigger. Avoid label toggles as substitute for ready_for_review.

The .github/ prefix is a full-run trigger, with narrow orchestration exemptions that explicitly do not cover .github/feature-matrix.d. This patch touches that fragment, so normal selector is expected full irrespective of core reverse-dependency selection. Verify actual selector output rather than assuming it.

Nightly full coverage and mutation measurement remain scheduled/manual freshness-governed lanes, not newly required ready-for-review work. Mutation remains advisory. No new schedule/manual override or dispatch is proposed.

root_execution_checks: After ready_for_review, verify exact b86 full selector for CI, feature-matrix, bench and new non-draft gate context; do not infer completion from superseded draft results.
Bench log must contain release build, deterministic-only emission including wasm_bundle_bytes and all memory metrics, then hard perf-gate result; ready itself is not evidence of a pass.
Coverage shard/engine measurement steps and both heavy recall test bodies must actually execute, with nonzero suites; retain ordinary job/floor conclusions.
New opt-in selected artifact/group/per-leg reporter proof is detailed in audit.json; grouping can change on the fresh full run, so bind all observations to that run/head.

coverage-measure.if: github.event_name != 'schedule' && github.event_name != 'merge_group' && (github.event_name != 'pull_request' || github.event.pull_request.draft != true) && needs.changes.outputs.rust_changed == 'true' && (needs.select.outputs.mode != 'selected' || needs.select.outputs.affected != '[]')
coverage-measure.name: coverage ratchet (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/3)

coverage-engine-run.if: github.event_name != 'schedule' && github.event_name != 'merge_group' && (github.event_name != 'pull_request' || github.event.pull_request.draft != true) && needs.changes.outputs.rust_changed == 'true' && (needs.select.outputs.mode != 'selected' || needs.select.outputs.affected != '[]')
coverage-engine-run.name: coverage engine run (partition ${{ matrix.part }}/3)

coverage.if:
always() && github.event_name != 'schedule' && (github.event_name != 'pull_request' ||
 !contains(fromJSON('["labeled","unlabeled"]'), github.event.action) ||
 github.event.label.name == 'ci-full') &&
(github.event_name != 'pull_request' || github.event.pull_request.draft != true)
coverage.name: coverage ratchet + test-presence gate (per-crate)

bench.if:
(github.event_name != 'pull_request' ||
 !contains(fromJSON('["labeled","unlabeled"]'), github.event.action) ||
 contains(fromJSON('["ci-full","bench-full"]'), github.event.label.name)) &&
(github.event_name != 'pull_request' || github.event.pull_request.draft != true) && (needs.select.outputs.mode != 'selected' ||
 contains(needs.select.outputs.affected, '"sparq-engine"') ||
 contains(needs.select.outputs.affected, '"sparq-cli"') ||
 contains(needs.select.outputs.affected, '"sparq-bench"') ||
 contains(needs.select.outputs.affected, '"sparq-wasm"'))
bench.name: run + track benchmarks
